summary: Blizzard stranded motorists on Highway 40 (Utah border to Craig) and Highway 318 (Utah border to Maybell); Moffat County Search and Rescue and the Sheriff's Office located and retrieved stranded motorists on Highway 318 by snowcat; approximately 19 people and one dog transported to the Maybell Community Center, then relayed to Craig where overnight accommodations were arranged
location: Highway 318, Utah border to Maybell (motorists retrieved on Hwy 318)
responding_agency: Moffat County Search and Rescue; Moffat County Sheriff's Office
notes: Date inferred as February 15, 2023: the report describes a Wednesday incident and includes a Friday February 17 update. The count of 19 people is approximate; one dog is not included. The source does not state injury status.
